review_improvement: Corrects the unsupported no-risk/read-only conclusion and prevents a raw NCSI control opcode from being sent to a guessed management channel without decoding or recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Raw protocol opcodes cannot be classified by the CLI word `raw`; their effect comes from the vendor/NCSI command definition and tool mode. Package 0/channel 0 are logical selectors, not reliable physical identities across platforms. A command can return bytes while still targeting the wrong channel or modifying initialization state. Because the BMC may use that channel for management connectivity, one unexpected state transition can disconnect the same session collecting evidence. Vendor semantics and an independent path are therefore mandatory before execution.
